symptom: A NativePhone bottom bar with a nested menu, a collection icon and a sign-out item passed check with only MDL077 warnings about a collapsed web sidebar (suggesting the collection icon exec then refuses); exec refused it naming one problem at a time; syntax navigation.create said a native profile refuses the { } block, then documented it (ako/mxcli#2561, ako/mxcli#2563).
cause: The bottom bar's limits (flat, page-only, glyph icon) were enforced only in the writer (navBottomBarItemBson), and the project-free check had only the web sidebar's icon rule; the syntax paragraph predated #1912's bottom bar support.
file: mdl/executor/validate_native_bottombar.go (new, MDL-NATIVEBAR01), validate_navigation_icons.go (skip native), validate_program.go, cmd/mxcli/syntax/features_misc.go
fix: MDL-NATIVEBAR01 errors in the project-free pass for each nested menu, collection/image icon and non-show-page OnClick (or show page with arguments); MDL077 skips a native profile; the syntax paragraph no longer says the bottom bar is refused.
insight: A writer that refuses a shape is half a rule: the same refusal belongs in check, or the agent learns the rule one exec failure at a time. When a rule is scoped to one variant of a construct (the web sidebar), check whether the construct has other variants it fires on — MDL077's suggestion was actively wrong for the native one.
test: mdl/executor/validate_native_bottombar_2561_test.go (three errors, no MDL077, a web profile control); fails against a stub rule; live: check reports all three with no project
